tiers.HOT: Active task manifests, current root and bounded role/dependency slices.
tiers.WARM: Recent sealed segments, accepted checkpoints, dossiers and provenance manifests.
tiers.COLD: Immutable raw objects, old event segments and large datasets; retrieve by manifest hit only.

context_rule: Never load the full Atlas/Annex/corpus/history into conversational context; page by cursor, byte/record limit and dependency scope.

sharding.unknown_key: Explicit UNKNOWN value plus open identity item; never invent an identity to obtain a shard.
sharding.key_serialization: Canonical JSON array of five strings under OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1; exact raw-source locator identity retained in descriptors, never normalized source bytes.
sharding.bucket: First two lowercase hex characters of SHA256(key_serialization UTF8), 256 fixed logical buckets.
sharding.partition_key: Dataset ID + semantic bucket + configured partition ID; configuration is immutable in dataset manifest.
sharding.stable_paths: state/mre3/<namespace>/<domain>/<bucket>/<segment_sha256>.jsonl; path components must be safe ASCII controlled tokens. Original evidence filenames remain unchanged.
sharding.resharding: New immutable dataset version with explicit old/new mapping; never silently remap or deduplicate raw provenance.

segments.format: Each record uses OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1 canonical bytes plus one LF; no BOM.
segments.seal: Record count, byte count, stream/sequence bounds and exact-byte SHA256; sealed segment immutable.
segments.event_hash: Apply OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1 to event excluding event_hash; next previous_event_hash must match.
segments.ordering: Declared stream sequence, never inferred physical execution chronology.
segments.append: Write new segment, not append to sealed segment.
segments.partial: Unsealed partial output stays EXECUTION staging and is not reachable from authoritative root.

immutable_sources.identity: Exact-byte SHA256 plus byte count; preserve original filenames, Unicode code points, line endings, duplicate materializations and variants.

storage_descriptors.lfs: Descriptor source hash/size must match pointer oid/size AND retrieved source bytes; a Git pointer is not source data.
storage_descriptors.remote_storage: Only explicitly public-distribution-authorized storage; no credentials embedded.
storage_descriptors.unavailable: Report OPEN/BLOCKED; do not infer source content.

dataset_roots.algorithm: SHA256 of OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1 bytes of {dataset_id, partition_strategy, source_sha256, source_byte_count, partitions}; partition rows sorted by NFC partition_id UTF8 bytes and include partition_id, sequence, sequence_total, input_hash, output_hash, byte_count, record_count. Require IDs unique after NFC.
dataset_roots.complete_requirement: All declared partitions SEALED_VERIFIED with expected coverage; only COMPLETE dataset roots may enter authoritative semantic state.
dataset_roots.partial_root: Candidate manifest only; never publish partial ingestion as COMPLETE.
dataset_roots.authority_gate: dataset_authoritative=true requires INGEST_COMPLETE, all declared input/output partition byte hashes and counts independently verified, dataset_root_hash independently recomputed and validated, complete manifest, and explicit master-controlled committed-root inclusion.
dataset_roots.thread_view_visibility: Every incomplete, partial, aborted, quarantined or unverified dataset is excluded from authoritative thread views and may appear only as explicit candidate/diagnostic execution state.

resumable_processing.resume: Check source hash, partition config and completed hashes before continuing; replay by immutable chunk ID.
resumable_processing.incomplete_ingestion: Quarantine candidate chunks and incomplete manifests outside authoritative root; no missing chunks fabricated.

derivatives.policy: Rebuild from immutable source/root/version; record input hashes and code version. Do not mistake generated Parquet for authoritative provenance.

transport.hash: SHA256 of canonical payload under OFG-EA-MRE3-CANONICAL-V1; envelope metadata validated separately.
transport.multipart: Declare complete inventory and sequence dependencies; isolate incomplete transport as EXECUTION, never authoritative semantic state.
transport.mobile: Bounded compact JSON and content refs; large operations require deterministic desktop handoff.

storage_backend_independence: object_id plus content_sha256 identifies semantic object; backend/location changes do not alter semantic identity. Preserve original locator bytes by byte-safe URI/escaped descriptor encoding.

ingest_lifecycle.normal_sequence: CREATED -> VALIDATING_SOURCE -> PARTITIONING -> PROCESSING -> VERIFYING -> COMPLETE
ingest_lifecycle.failure_transitions: Any nonterminal state may transition to ABORTED or QUARANTINED, preserving immutable completed partition objects and diagnostic journal. No terminal COMPLETE dataset is silently edited.
ingest_lifecycle.resume: Revalidate source descriptor and exact source hash/size, partition configuration and all completed hashes before resuming PROCESSING with a new journal entry; changed source/configuration requires a new ingest_id.
ingest_lifecycle.verification_failure: Quarantine corrupt partition and incomplete manifest; dataset_authoritative remains false and authoritative views exclude candidate data. Repair/retry only from verified immutable source.
ingest_lifecycle.completion: Exact partition count, completed count, unique NFC IDs, sequence coverage, byte/record counts, input/output hashes and dataset root must validate. Explicit master acceptance and committed-root inclusion are additionally required before an authoritative view may reference the dataset.
